Afterwards, the temple's cleric died by mysterious causes, and the statue began to weep tears of blood once again. All at once, the people of the area began to fear the statue, and sealed it deep beneath the earth along with its jewels.

id: Ada seorang ksatria yang tinggal di tanah yang jauh. Ksatria ini memakai cincin sebagai simbol cintanya dengan peri Nallia. Cincin ini juga memberinya kekuatan untuk pulih dari luka apa pun. Dia menggunakan sihir cincin ini untuk memenangkan peperangan, dan dia bertunangan dengan ratu dari negara yang dilayaninya. Tapi, pada hari pernikahan mereka, dia melepas cincin peri itu. Pada saat itu, musuh negara itu menyerang gerbang dan menghancurkannya seketika. Cincin peri itu tak pernah terlihat sejak itu.
name: MST_LSSPHERE_230006_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a knight who lived in a faraway land. This knight wore a ring that symbolized the love and affection he shared with the pixie Nallia. This ring also endowed him with the power to recover from any wound. He used the ring's magic to win glory in battle, and on doing so, he became engaged to the queen of the nation he served. However, on the day of their wedding, he removed the pixie's ring. In that instant, the nation's enemies stormed its gates and annihilated it completely. The pixie's ring has not been seen since.

desc: A torture implement once used with loving care by a sadistic young tyrant. The gods attempted to visit numerous punishments upon this tyrant for his loathsome ways, but the tyrant forced his magician to transform the torturer's needle into a decoy. The needle gained fearsome power as the gods' wrath passed through it time and again, eventually becoming a weapon so destructive it could threaten the gods themselves.

id: Tongkat yang diberikan dari generasi ke generasi di kerajaan kuno Lagfarita. Meskipun Lagfarita damai untuk bertahun-tahun, suku barbar mulai menyerang perbatasannya. Prajurit Lagfarita kesulitan melawan barbar yang kuat, dan perbatasannya mulai berjatuhan. Lalu, suatu hari semuanya berhenti ketika sang raja menggunakan tongkat ini dan semua serangan suku barbar menjadi tak efektif. name: MST_LSSPHERE_230206_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A scepter passed down over generations in the ancient kingdom of Lagfarita. Though Lagfarita had enjoyed peace for many years, barbarian tribesmen began to raid its borders. Then, one day it came to an end when the king brandished this scepter and all the barbarians' attacks were rendered ineffectual. The tide of the war turned suddenly, and Lagfarita was able to drive off the barbarians at last.

id: Pedang yang dibuat dengan sangat baik ini katanya ditempa dari sinar matahari di masa lalu. Sang pembuat pedang juga mengorbankan nyawanya untuk membuat pedang ini. name: MST_LSSPHERE_239000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This masterfully crafted sword is said to have been forged from sunlight in the distant past. In crafting it, the master smith also sacrificed his own life. id: Zirah yang dibuat dari sisa-sisa boneka sihir. Ilmuwan memberikan konfirmasi bahwa zirah ini punya kemampuan untuk menambah attribut penggunanya dengan hebat. Pembuatan benda itu membutuhkan sisa-sisa boneka yang masih mempunyai kekuatan Zirah Ilahi, membuat produksi secara massal tidak mungkin. desc: Armor made by rearranging the remains of an enchanted puppet. Researchers have confirmed that it has the power to greatly enhance the wearer's basic attributes. desc: A ring that appears through scattered references in poems. In an ancient era, a goddess fell in love with a human youth. However, one day the youth was conscripted for a hopeless battle. It is said that under the goddess's protection, the youth and his companions went on fighting no matter how many injuries they sustained, and in the end succeeded in protecting their homeland.

id: Jimat ini diciptakan dari hasrat eksploitasi militer mumpuni. Pemilik jimat mati dalam perang akibat tindakan heroiknya. Jimat beralih tangan ke si pembunuh, dan setelah prestasi memukau di medan perang lain, mereka juga mati. Pemilik berikutnya dan berikutnya juga mati dalam perang setelah berprestasi tinggi. desc: This talisman was created out of the desire for distinguished military exploits. The owner of that talisman died in battle as a price for his heroic feats. The next owner and the one after also died in battle after their many deeds won them acclaim. After countless warriors gave their lives for this talisman, it came to be said that the spirit of a war god dwelled within it.

id: Zaman dahulu ada kerajaan dunia lain bernama Akbutecca. Di kerajaan dalam dunia yang sudah benar-benar hancur, hiduplah jenderal terkenal yang disebut "Tameng Suci". Dia menghadapi penyerang dari dunia lain, dan memanfaatkan semua jenis taktik dan strategi militer sepenuhnya. Setiap baris serangan digagalkan dan akhirnya mereka membatalkan invasi. Rakyat kerajaan ini diperkirakan mengetahui rahasia ritual untuk mewariskan jiwa. Dan jiwa sang jenderal masuk ke dalam siapa pun yang memakai mahkota ini.
name: MST_LSSPHERE_230207_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was an otherworldly kingdom named Akbutecca. In that kingdom within a world already completely destroyed, there lived a famous general called the “Sacred Shield.” He took on otherworldly invaders, and making full use of all types of military tactics and strategies, he thwarted every line of attack and eventually forced them to abandon the invasion. It is thought by some that the people of this kingdom knew of a secret ritual to inherit souls, and the general's soul is said to pass into whoever wears this crown.

desc: A sacred relic excavated from the ruins of a certain otherworldly temple. The sense of faith continued to accumulate in the precious chalice, until it eventually came to contain greater power than even the gods themselves.

id: Cermin suci yang diberikan dewa untuk menghargai keluarga bangsawan. Keluarga itu dipercaya memerintah negara oleh dewa, tapi otoritasnya makin berkurang setiap berganti generasi. Negara lalu diinvasi setan dan krisis. Kaisar saat itu hanya orang biasa, tapi sepertinya bertransformasi dan menampilkan kemampuan memukau begitu dia melihat ke cermin suci ini. Ia lalu mengomando tentara dan berhasil mengusir setan.
name: MST_LSSPHERE_236001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A sacred mirror given by a god in recognition of a country's royal family. That family is thought to have been entrusted with the country's governance by the god, but its authority declined with each generation. In the midst of this decline, the country was invaded by a demon and plunged into crisis. The emperor by that time was merely an ordinary person, but seemed transformed and displayed astonishing ability the moment he looked into this sacred mirror. He is said to have gone on to command an army and successfully drove out the demon.

id: Ornamen yang dimodel sesuai aksesori yang dipakai dua dewa yang melayani Kaisar Suci. Meski imitasi, ini berkekuatan menaikkan kemampuan dasar seseorang menjadi level super manusia, seakan pamer beda besar antara dewa dan manusia. Berbagai bentuk perlindungan diaktifkan tergantung situasi, seakan mencermnkan roh dua dewa yang berbeda, yang lebih jauh dipercaya daripada Kaisar Suci sendiri. Banyak yang percaya ini memberi kekuatan ornamen untuk memandu pemakainya langsung menuju kemenangan.
name: MST_LSSPHERE_235003_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An ornament that was modeled after accessories worn by the two gods who served under the Holy Emperor. Even though it is an imitation, it has the power to raise one's basic abilities to a superhuman level, as if to show the great difference between gods and humans. Furthermore, various forms of protection are activated depending on the circumstances, as if to reflect the spirit of the two different gods, who were trusted more deeply than the Holy Emperor himself. Many believe this grants the ornament power to guide the wearer straight to victory.

id: There once was a race that read the future in the stars. One night, they observed a new star in the heavens. It was an ill omen, signifying the race's impending doom. Resolving to resist this fate, their young leader donned their traditional red garb and made his way to the battlefield. Inspired by the young leader's courage, a miraculous victory was seized from the jaws of defeat. Their legends tell us that they abandoned prophecy from that point onward, choosing instead to forge their own fates.

However, as the technology itself is now lost, the otherworldly investigation office has attempted to reproduce it. This equippable Sphere is one such successful attempt. It boasts the ability to greatly enhance the powers of all neighboring allies, along with the wielder. It is particularly well-suited to mass enemy elimination, for which it could be called optimal.

id: A magically-enhanced armor developed from further research into the remains of Rokkzalm's demon puppets. Though less heavily armored than the Armored Soul, it features a crystal in its center which consists of the concentrated essence of the Divine Armor. This enhances its performance in all fields far beyond that of the Armored Soul. Its developer has stated that the loss of physical defense was a sacrifice required in order to heighten the Sealed God powers imbued in the piece.
